mapper.select: select user_id, activity_id, out_business_no, status, create_time, update_time from raffle_quota_decrement_ledger where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and out_business_no = #{outBusinessNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update raffle_quota_decrement_ledger set status = 'rolled_back', update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and out_business_no = #{outBusinessNo} and status = 'applied'
